name: Bloody Waters
source:
After years of grunt lab work, Dawn is ready to make a real difference— and she's given the chance to do so when her friend gets her a job at a mysterious lab. But something about one of the creatures there is odd, and she can't seem to keep her head above water as a chance meeting spirals out of control.

[From [url=https://heartsoulstudios.itch.io/bloody-waters]itch.io[/url]]
